caption: The drawing displays six square fabric swatches arranged in two columns and three rows against a plain beige background. The top left swatch features a cream base with a zigzag pattern in light blue and interspersed diamond shapes in yellow and red. The top right swatch is black with a floral design consisting of red and pink flowers with green leaves and stems. The middle left swatch has a vertical stripe pattern with alternating bands of detailed brown and tan motifs, blue dots, and red geometric shapes. The middle right swatch shows a beige background with a woven basket-like pattern made of thin black diagonal lines, occasionally accented by small red dots. The bottom left swatch is deep maroon with a repeating floral motif in red, white, and pink, displaying stylized flowers and foliage. The bottom right swatch is pink with a regular arrangement of red and pink circular medallions, each containing a simple floral design.
title: Quilt Patches
